name: A shared replay link restores its moment, view, mode and card (signed in)
description: Validates the URL state: a link with t, view, mode and layer reopens that exact state, Escape closes the card and drops only the layer from the URL, and a link with unknown values falls back to the defaults instead of failing.

planSteps.description: Type testsprite-console-12+clerk_test@example.com in the "Email address" field and click Continue
Wait until the code screen ("Check your email") shows "Didn't receive a code?", then type 424242; Clerk usually continues by itself after the 6th digit, so click Continue only if it is still shown

If Clerk answers "You need to send a verification code before attempting to verify", click Resend once it is enabled and type 424242 again; then wait up to 30 seconds until the URL is no longer under /sign-in
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T16:44Z&view=top&mode=evidence&layer=cut-c-lion1 and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"

Assert the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "16:44 UTC", "From above" is pressed in the view switch (data-testid view-switch), and "Evidence" is pressed in the mode switch (data-testid mode-switch)
Assert a card (data-testid cut-card) titled "C-Lion1 cut" is open
Assert the cut card is closed and the URL query still has t=2024-12-25T16:44Z, view=top and mode=evidence but no layer
Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=yesterday&view=sideways&mode=cinema&layer=cut-nowhere and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the page shows the replay console with no error, the replay clock reads "10:26 UTC", "Overview" and "Replay" are pressed, and no cut card is open
